title: agentopt.yaml
description: User-owned configuration file at the project root. Scaffolded by `agentopt init`; every value is editable by hand at any time.

run.description: How agentopt invokes the user's agent. Exactly one invocation style must be set.

command.description: Subprocess command parsed into an argument list without a shell; {input} is replaced with the eval input.

http.description: HTTP harness: agentopt boots the server with the wiretap hook and sends each input as a request. Secrets go in ${ENV_VAR}; the input is substituted for {input}.

url.description: Endpoint that receives each eval input.

body.description: Request body template; {input} is the eval input.

output.description: Dot-path to the reply in the JSON response, e.g. $.reply.

start.description: Command agentopt runs to boot the server with the hook.

ready.description: URL polled until the server responds.

ready_timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for readiness.

request_timeout_ms.description: Per-request bound on the agent HTTP call (a hung endpoint must not stall the run). Default 120000.

python.description: Import path of a callable, e.g. my_agent.main:run_agent.

node.description: Module path and exported callable for the Node package, e.g. agentopt.entry.mjs:run.

improver.description: Models powering the improvement loop. Suggested at init, never hardcoded; roles may point at different backends.

delegate.description: Run the tier-4 code delegate (the agent that edits files) on a specific coding CLI, independent of `backend`. Unset = derive from `backend`.

judge_command.description: A command that scores outputs instead of the built-in LLM judge (reads a JSON payload on stdin, prints a JSON {score} on stdout).

judge_samples.description: Self-consistency for the LLM judge: median of re-samples on borderline gradings. 1 disables.

judge_backend.description: Run the judge on a separate backend from the optimizer/delegate. Unset = share the main backend.

judge_base_url.description: For a judge_backend: cloud judge, the OpenAI-compatible endpoint to grade against (provider-generic: Fireworks, Together, Groq, ...). Falls back to OPENAI_BASE_URL.

judge_api_key_env.description: Name of the env var holding the cloud judge's API key (e.g. FIREWORKS_API_KEY). Falls back to OPENAI_API_KEY.

runs_per_check.description: Agent runs per eval input; auto picks by check type.

eval_concurrency.description: How many agent runs to score concurrently (bounded pool). Peak memory scales with this. 1 = serial.

min_effect_pp.description: Minimum paired net gain (pp) a change must clear to be accepted — the noise floor (#7). Default 1.0.

reliability_regression_tolerance.description: How far candidate execution reliability may fall below baseline (fraction) before the change is rejected on reliability — the reliability gate runs BEFORE quality. Default 0.02.

judge_concurrency.description: How many judge gradings to run concurrently. Speeds up an async/HTTP (cloud) judge; safe (stateless). 1 = serial.

explore.description: Diverse candidates generated and probed per cluster each round.

delegate_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock budget for one code-delegate attempt; on expiry it is killed and its edits reverted.

code_attempts.description: Stochastic multi-attempt per failing cluster in code-only mode. 1 = single attempt.

stop_when_stuck.description: Give up after this many fruitless iterations.

require_holdout_gain.description: Require unseen-data gain, not just non-regression.

max_versions_per_run.description: Stop after creating this many versions (applied fixes) in one run.

generate_challenges.description: When every check passes, invent adversarial challenges and keep improving (evolve mode).

production.description: The model the agent runs on in production; all optimization is validated against this.

allowed.description: Pool the optimizer may test and suggest as replacements.

never.description: Models/patterns that must never be suggested (compliance, preference). Supports trailing-* glob.

include.description: Extra glob paths to include as context (things invisible to tracing).

protected.description: Glob paths that may be read but never edited.

max_tokens_per_run.description: Hard cap on agent tokens consumed by one improve run.

redact.description: Project-specific regular expressions applied by the review-time redactor. Trace-at-rest redaction is not currently enforced.

retention_days.description: Reserved retention target in days; automatic trace cleanup is not currently enforced.
